It seems there is some problem sending a message 

org.apache.spark.scheduler.SparkListenerBus$class.doPostEvent(SparkListenerBus.scala:37)

to 

org.apache.zeppelin.spark.NewSparkInterpreter$1.onJobStart(NewSparkInterpreter.java:225)

So Zeppelin doesn't catch onJobStart event - so it doesn't know job id I guess etc, so it causes

  • no progress bar
  • no link to Spark Job in Spark Driver ID
  • can't cancel a job.

I looked at the code, it happens at the same line on both New and OldSparkInterpreter:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/d762b5288536201d8a2964891c556efaa1bae867/spark/interpreter/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/spark/NewSparkInterpreter.java#L225

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/d1293c6bc476378c57db47d48dd8c5355370bb8a/spark/interpreter/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/spark/OldSparkInterpreter.java#L201

Code that leads to NPE 

   String noteId = Utils.getNoteId(jobGroupId);

Actual line that produces NPE, line 156 in spark/interpreter/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/spark/Utils.java :

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/d762b5288536201d8a2964891c556efaa1bae867/spark/interpreter/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/spark/Utils.java#L156

public static String getNoteId(String jobgroupId) {
     int indexOf = jobgroupId.indexOf("-");

So `jobgroupId` is somehow Null here... any ideas how to fix / workaround this?

So the problem is in line

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/d1293c6bc476378c57db47d48dd8c5355370bb8a/spark/interpreter/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/spark/OldSparkInterpreter.java#L198

that's where jobGroupId is defined in line 198 of spark/interpreter/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/spark/OldSparkInterpreter.java

public synchronized void onJobStart(SparkListenerJobStart jobStart) {
   int jobId = jobStart.jobId();
   String jobGroupId = jobStart.properties().getProperty("spark.jobGroup.id");

 - see last line. So the new Zeppelin expects `spark.jobGroup.id` property to be set? How do we define it?

From https://jaceklaskowski.gitbooks.io/mastering-apache-spark/content/spark-webui-JobProgressListener.html#onJobStart 

onJobStart Callback

onJobStart(jobStart: SparkListenerJobStart): Unit

onJobStart creates a JobUIData.

It updates jobGroupToJobIds, pendingStages, jobIdToData, activeJobs, stageIdToActiveJobIds, stageIdToInfo and stageIdToData.

 
onJobStart reads the optional Spark Job group id as spark.jobGroup.id (from properties in the input jobStart). 

 

 

zjffdu Please notice spark.jobGroup.id is optional.. So new Zeppelin expects it to be set as a Spark interpreter setting?
